ratio_definition: exp(mean paired change in log(1+IgE)); a ratio of 1+IgE, not a raw arithmetic-mean IgE fold change

table_roles.mi_log_levels.csv: Back-transformed log means. No level-versus-zero p values are reported; these would not test treatment efficacy.
table_roles.mi_log_changes.csv: Within-group change; estimates and intervals on log(1+IgE), ratio fields exponentiated. Exploratory unadjusted p values, no confirmatory efficacy claims.
table_roles.mi_adjusted_contrasts.csv: Pairwise initial-strategy associations; existing baseline overlap weights held fixed; uncertainty conditional on those weights. No causal fixed-dose effect.
table_roles.method_comparison.csv: All4 methods from same named source population. Pairwise observed subset and MAR-target population differ; use n_observed_pairs for raw data, not n_model_or_group as a group-specific observed denominator. LMM n_model_or_group is total informative patients across treatments.

predictive_scope: Imputation uses retrospective cross-wave clinical auxiliaries, including future visits; it is not a prospective individual prediction model.
